title: Copilot Memory — Official Exam Facts
summary: Choose memory strategies, persist durable state, prevent context drift, and maintain task continuity — including Copilot Memory specifics tested directly on the exam.

items: **Scope:** **Repository-scoped** — all permitted users in a repo share its memories; no cross-repo
**Default (Pro/Pro+):** **ON by default** — users can opt out in personal settings
**Default (Enterprise/Org):** **OFF by default** — admin must enable at org/enterprise level
**Validation:** Citation-based — each memory has code location references validated against current branch before use
**Active in:** Copilot cloud agent, Copilot code review (GitHub.com PRs), Copilot CLI

blocks.text: **Exam Trap:** Memory is repo-scoped, NOT user-scoped. Developer A's memory in Repo X is available to Developer B in Repo X — but NOT to Developer A in Repo Y.
